title: Confidence table: age of last reading × usable pairs, every cell
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance, press New schedule and create a throwaway schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' holding one routine service per reading you will seed, named 'ZZ Seed 1', 'ZZ Seed 2' and so on, each with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and no canned lines. Save. (If it already exists, reuse it.)
  3. In Settings > Maintenance create a schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' with one service 'PM-M': a Distance trigger set At 360,000 mileage and a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months. Save.
  4. Create ten units, 'ZZAUTOTEST 520' to 'ZZAUTOTEST 529', each as follows: Open Customers > 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' > Assets and create unit '<unit>' with New Asset, leaving Mileage and Engine Hours empty. On its Maintenance tab press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' and give every seed service a last service date five years ago (for example 6 Oct 2021), so each seed service reads Overdue and shows on the work order card; press Enroll. Enroll the unit on 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' too, with PM-M last done today.
  5. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 520' (oldest first): 1) 20 days before today (e.g. 16 Sep 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 10 days before today (e.g. 26 Sep 2026) · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 10 days old, 1 usable pair)
  6. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 521' (oldest first): 1) 30 days before today (e.g. 6 Sep 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 20 days before today (e.g. 16 Sep 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 10 days before today (e.g. 26 Sep 2026) · 302,000 mileage. (last reading 10 days old, 2 usable pairs)
  7. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 522' (oldest first): 1) 70 days before today (e.g. 28 Jul 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 60 days before today (e.g. 7 Aug 2026) · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 60 days old, 1 usable pair)
  8. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 523' (oldest first): 1) 80 days before today (e.g. 18 Jul 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 70 days before today (e.g. 28 Jul 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 60 days before today (e.g. 7 Aug 2026) · 302,000 mileage. (last reading 60 days old, 2 usable pairs)
  9. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 524' (oldest first): 1) 100 days before today (e.g. 28 Jun 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 90 days before today (e.g. 8 Jul 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 80 days before today (e.g. 18 Jul 2026) · 302,000 mileage; 4) 70 days before today (e.g. 28 Jul 2026) · 303,000 mileage; 5) 60 days before today (e.g. 7 Aug 2026) · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 60 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  10. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 525' (oldest first): 1) 130 days before today (e.g. 29 May 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 120 days before today (e.g. 8 Jun 2026) · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 120 days old, 1 usable pair)
  11. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 526' (oldest first): 1) 140 days before today (e.g. 19 May 2026) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 130 days before today (e.g. 29 May 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 120 days before today (e.g. 8 Jun 2026) · 302,000 mileage. (last reading 120 days old, 2 usable pairs)
  12. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 527' (oldest first): 1) 280 days before today (e.g. 30 Dec 2025) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 270 days before today (e.g. 9 Jan 2026) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 260 days before today (e.g. 19 Jan 2026) · 302,000 mileage; 4) 250 days before today (e.g. 29 Jan 2026) · 303,000 mileage. (last reading 250 days old, 3 usable pairs)
  13. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 528' (oldest first): 1) 290 days before today (e.g. 20 Dec 2025) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 280 days before today (e.g. 30 Dec 2025) · 301,000 mileage; 3) 270 days before today (e.g. 9 Jan 2026) · 302,000 mileage; 4) 260 days before today (e.g. 19 Jan 2026) · 303,000 mileage; 5) 250 days before today (e.g. 29 Jan 2026) · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 250 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  14. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 529' (oldest first): 1) 410 days before today (e.g. 22 Aug 2025) · 300,000 mileage; 2) 400 days before today (e.g. 1 Sep 2025) · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 400 days old, 1 usable pair)
  15. Count every date back from the day you run the case; the date in brackets is only the example for a run on 6 Oct 2026. Seed and read on the same day, because an estimate and a reading's age both count days up to today. Readings are 10 days apart and add 1,000 each, so every pair is usable.
  16. Seed each reading in the table, oldest first: open Work Orders and press New Work Order for the unit; type the reading's mileage in the work order's Mileage field (and its engine hours in Engine Hours where the table gives one; leave the field untouched where it does not) and save; expand the Maintenance schedule card, open the three-dot menu of a seed service not used yet, choose Mark complete, keep On a work order with this work order chosen, set Reset date to the reading's date and press Mark complete. That work order's values become readings dated the Reset date. Confirm any warning the field shows.
  17. When every reading is in: on the unit's Maintenance tab open the 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' schedule's menu, choose Remove from schedule and confirm, so the seed services add no rows. Check the Mileage card's last recorded value and date match the table's last reading.
  18. If Mark complete does not record a seeded reading (the Mileage or Engine Hours card does not show that value and date afterwards), stop: mark this case Blocked and write "seeding failed: Mark complete did not record the reading" in the result comment. That is a separate problem with its own case, not a failure of this one.
custom_steps:
1. Open each unit's Maintenance tab and read the confidence word under PM-M's due month (and on the Mileage card).
  2. Compare each with the table: up to 30 days: 1 pair Medium, 2 or more High; 31 to 90: 1 Low, 2 or 3 Medium, 4 or more High; 91 to 180: 1 Low, 2 or more Medium; 181 to 365: 4 or more Medium, fewer Low; over 365: Low.
  3. On unit 522 (60 days, 1 pair) create a new work order, type 307,000 in its Mileage field and save, but do not invoice it. Read the confidence again.
  4. Invoice that work order (Finance > Create Invoice, record the payment). Read the confidence again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 520: last reading 10 days old (up to 30 days), 1 usable pair → Medium confidence.
  • 521: last reading 10 days old (up to 30 days), 2 usable pairs → High confidence.
  • 522: last reading 60 days old (31 to 90 days), 1 usable pair → Low confidence.
  • 523: last reading 60 days old (31 to 90 days), 2 usable pairs → Medium confidence.
  • 524: last reading 60 days old (31 to 90 days), 4 usable pairs → High confidence.
  • 525: last reading 120 days old (91 to 180 days), 1 usable pair → Low confidence.
  • 526: last reading 120 days old (91 to 180 days), 2 usable pairs → Medium confidence.
  • 527: last reading 250 days old (181 to 365 days), 3 usable pairs → Low confidence.
  • 528: last reading 250 days old (181 to 365 days), 4 usable pairs → Medium confidence.
  • 529: last reading 400 days old (over 365 days), 1 usable pair → Low confidence.
  • With the In the shop value 307,000 on an open work order, unit 522 still reads Low and its last reading is still 60 days old.
  • Once that work order is invoiced, 307,000 is recorded today: unit 522 now has 2 usable pairs read today and reads High.
  • Every grade matches the one table that ships with the specification beneath the requirements.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R22: “Confidence comes from one table that reads two things together: how old the unit's last recorded reading is, and how many usable pairs it has. Every combination has its own cell, given in S11-R24 and in the table beneath these requirements. Nothing is graded separately and nothing caps anything”
  • S11-R24: “By age of the last recorded reading, then usable pairs. Up to 30 days: one pair Medium, two or more High. 31 to 90 days: one pair Low, two or three Medium, four or more High. 91 to 180 days: one pair Low, two or more Medium. 181 to 365 days: four or more Medium, fewer Low. Over 365 days: Low. A value shown In the shop per S10-R11 is not yet recorded and does not refresh the age until its work order is invoiced”
  • S11-R21: “The complete matrix ships with the specification as one table for the build, directly beneath these requirements: readings counted, age of the last reading, the confidence that follows, and what the row renders. The rules are spread across S11 and S12 and an engineer needs them side by side”
  • S18-R19: “Mark complete On a work order also records that work order's mileage and engine hours as the asset's readings, dated the Reset date”
